scenario: A computational chemist uses a biomedical research toolkit to retrieve literature-validated compound series for a kinase target, profiles each candidate through a pharmacology ADME agent, then runs a full ADMET safety screen to produce a ranked lead list with go/no-go recommendations.
info_flow: medical-research-toolkit retrieves ChEMBL bioactivity data and returns compound SMILES with potency annotations → pharma-pharmacology-agent profiles each SMILES for ADME/drug-likeness and produces a JSON report → admet-prediction ingests the ADME report to compute the full ADMET safety profile and emits a go/no-go recommendation per compound.
